ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Sponsor sales, Proposal sent and later stages need Sponsor tier and Amount.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Sponsor_sales", CASE(StageName, "Prospect", 1, "Meeting held", 2, "Proposal sent", 3, "Negotiating", 4, "Contract out", 5, "Signed", 6, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Sponsor_tier__c)), ISBLANK(Amount)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Sponsor tier and Amount before moving to Proposal sent.
